# Copilot repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
and [README.md](../README.md). Those files define the public synthetic-only
boundary, isolated contribution workflow and canonical public Brain skill
pointer. They do not depend on a developer's personal home-directory policy.

This is an instruction-only starter, not an installed runtime or authorized
private Brain source. Do not infer access, installation or deployment permission
from these instructions.
